description: Record a finite raw stream from selected physical channels, or provide start/stop lifecycle primitives to a composition that owns the TimeTagger lease-root and guarantees closure.
summary: Record a finite time-tag stream or provide recording lifecycle primitives.

deviceId.description: TimeTagger device that records the raw stream.

operation.description: record completes one finite acquisition. start and stop are lifecycle primitives only for a composition that owns the TimeTagger lease-root: immediately after start it must register terminal cleanup, then stop the same recordingRef on every normal path.

channelRefs.description: Physical TimeTagger channels written into the stream; required for record and start, ignored by stop.

durationSec.description: Finite recording duration in seconds; required only for operation record. Must be omitted or null for start; unused for stop.

recordingRef.description: Caller-stable label retained in the device-side artifact metadata.

recordingSubdirectory.description: Optional device-side directory below the driver's recording root.

marker.description: Optional marker recorded by the device with the raw stream.

maxFileSizeBytes.description: Optional maximum raw-stream file size accepted by the device.

acquisition.rawStream.plan.recording.description: Requested operation, resolved device/channels when applicable, duration, and caller recording label.

acquisition.rawStream.status.recording.description: Active-stream descriptor returned by operation start; null after record or stop.

acquisition.rawStream.observation.record.description: Raw successful device recording response, including writer statistics when provided.

acquisition.rawStream.artifact.deviceFil.description: Manifest for the completed device-side raw-stream file set, including the entry file and every numbered data segment; null after start.
